answer: Each agent locks a 500-token bond in the basalt escrow contract before it can answer or grade. Peers who catch a cloned or forged answer post proof to the ledge dispute queue. If the proof holds, the whole bond is slashed: half is burned and half goes to the reporter. A sybil farm of 100 juniper accounts puts 50,000 tokens at risk, and every clone that gets caught loses its full stake.
